items.title: G.O.A.T.
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who is the greatest of all time? You, when you choose from 8 different magnificent goat skins! Role-play as farm animals with horns, beards and golden crowns, showing your greatness off to everyone. Become a royal ruler and just plain maaah-velous.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Fish Tank Heads
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
These skins are perfect for marine lovers! Gear up in an amazing diving suit topped off with a fish for a head in a tank of water. Choose from 12 unique skins that will give you an awesome aquatic look. Role-play as a deep sea diver ready to explore any ocean.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Tag Team Parkour
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Tag! It’s your turn! Get ready to chase and be chased when you role-play the fun sport of parkour. Flipping and jumping, rolling and climbing, try not to get tagged. Choose from 8 super cool skins to get past all the obstacles in your way. Enjoy getting fit and having a good time!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Rainbow Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Gear up as some of the cutest mobs ever! Choose from 8 rainbow-themed skins with plenty of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple stripes. Role-play as a mobile entity in colorful outfits with cool hoodies, pants, and shoes. Become a passive, neutral, or hostile mob in awesome rainbow style.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Lucky Rainbow Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Test your luck with the Rainbow Lucky Blocks! Destroy the Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Skyblock experience!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Skyblock Rainbow Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Test your skills with the SKYBLOCK RAINBOW LUCKY BLOCKS challenge! Build from island to island and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Skyblock experience
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Trendy Fashionistas
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You want to wear luxurious clothes and be one of the fashion teens? With these 8 skins you will be one of the coolest among your friends!

+2 free skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Lucky Blocks Rainbow
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Test your luck with the RAINBOW LUCKY BLOCKS! Destroy the Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Ultimate Parkour
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Can you beat all 60 levels? It won't be easy! Get your ultimate parkour experience. Improve and train the skill. The road to the title of overpowered jumper is very long! Explore 10 various themes and become the best. 

+ 60 Levels
+ 10 Unique Themes
+ By In Mine

items.title: Hacker Arena
items.creator: Ninja Block
items.description: You've been brought to the future somehow, in an arena full of scary monsters. Your mission: get out alive by killing them all to ensure survival. Progress and evolve with super hacker swords and armors.

items.title: Cool Anime Masks
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Are you an anime lover? The coolest masks are here, put on your favourite now and impress your friends!

- 12 anime-themed skins.
- 2 free skins!
- By rvan

items.title: Tree Ores
items.creator: Volcano
items.description:
Ever heard the expression "money doesn't grow on trees"? Well, what if it did! 
Grow your very own diamond tree with Tree Ores, and increase your ore supply by farming instead of mining!

Includes ten tree types: Coal, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald, Quartz, Lapis, Redstone, Netherite & Copper!

items.title: Pink Glitches
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
These beautiful, pink glitches are among us! They are a rare species of life. You'd be lucky to catch even a glimpse of these unique entities in the universe!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Cool and pretty glitches inspired by pink!

items.title: Sunday Night Party
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
For many, Sunday is a sort of special kind of day. It's the end of the weekend, but that doesn't mean the fun has to end! Let the good times roll until the end! Let's go!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fun and quirky attire inspired by Sunday night parties!

items.title: Block Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have the advantage and the style to blend into your surroundings! Camo at its finest! 

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute, camouflage attire inspired by Minecraft blocks!

items.title: Gradient Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Sometimes one color isn't enough to showcase your awesome vibe! That's why we have gradients! Feel your own awesomeness!

+ 20 roleplay skins!
+ Colorful attire inspired by gradients!

items.title: Demon Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Demons have possessed these unholy armors, imbuing their essence unto their wielders. Donning this armor grants brutal strength and a curse upon it's wielder for life. Will you take up this power and achieve your desires?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fantasy, battle attire!

items.title: Anonymous
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
In this day in age, you can never be too careful about security. Stay anonymous. Hide your identity. You never know.

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Secret attire inspired by anonymous!

items.title: Crimson Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Crimson. The symbol of the royal. The flames. The blood. The very embodiment of crimson demons!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute and casual attire inspired by crimson!

items.title: Galaxy Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Demons from out of this world! Inspired by the galaxy with cool space shading these demons are cool as the cosmos!

items.title: White Out
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: White Out! Don't get messy and look clean with these bright and modern skins featuring the color white!

items.title: Winter Anime HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Enjoy this collection of cute anime teens dressed in the best winter fashion for the season! Comes in various shades of blue with snowy themed pixel art and detailed sweater prints.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Trendy Fall Teens HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
The leaves are turning and the weather is changing. Suit up in some adorable and trendy fall fashion with this cool skin pack! A warm collection of red, orange, and yellow colors to choose from. 

+ 15 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Block Camo Teens
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
You look outside your newly made house which looks over the valley! You only see the green grass, but could there be someone amongst the field? Hide and troll your buddies using the camouflaged onesies! 

+ 14 skins!
+ Troll your friends!
